invariants.rationale: The method commitInternal uses instantTime to identify the commit, so it must not be null.
partitionPath is used as a key in the singletonMap in the main call, so it needs to be non-null.
records is stored in a map and used to process data, so it should not be null at entry.
indexParser may be required during commit, thus should not be null at method entry.
instantTime is expected to be a non-empty identifier for the operation.
